# Bath Professional — Tampa Bay Bathtub Refinishing, Reglazing & Resurfacing

> Bath Professional is Tampa and the Tampa Bay area's #1 rated bathtub refinishing, tub reglazing, and bathroom/kitchen surface resurfacing company. Rated 5.0 out of 5 stars across 444+ verified Google reviews, Bath Professional restores porcelain, fiberglass, cast iron, acrylic, ceramic tile, Formica, and cultured marble surfaces in 2–4 hours—saving homeowners, hotels, and property managers over 80% compared to replacement.

## Core Services
- [Bathtub Refinishing & Reglazing](https://bath-professional.com/#bathtub-refinishing-tampa): Restore fiberglass, steel, porcelain, cast iron, clawfoot, and acrylic tubs to brand-new factory gloss in 2–4 hours. Includes chip, crack, hole, and rust repair plus optional non-skid bottom treatment.
- [Shower Refinishing & Resurfacing](https://bath-professional.com/#shower-refinishing-tampa): Revitalize stained, chipped, and hard-to-clean fiberglass, acrylic, and tiled shower stalls and pans without demolition.
- [Tile & Grout Refinishing](https://bath-professional.com/#tile-refinishing-tampa): Re-glaze ceramic and porcelain bathroom wall/floor tile and permanently seal grout lines without tearing out walls.
- [Countertop Refinishing](https://bath-professional.com/#countertop-refinishing-tampa): Transform kitchen and bathroom vanity countertops (Formica, laminate, cultured marble, tile) with durable Multi-Stone finishes.
- [Cabinet Refinishing](https://bath-professional.com/#cabinet-refinishing-tampa): Refresh worn bathroom vanities and kitchen cabinetry at a fraction of replacement cost.
- [Sink Refinishing & Porcelain Repair](https://bath-professional.com/#sink-refinishing-tampa): Restore porcelain, fiberglass, and cultured marble bathroom and kitchen sinks; repair chips, cracks, holes, and rust.
- [Residential Refinishing](https://bath-professional.com/#residential-refinishing-tampa): Same-day bathroom and kitchen surface restoration for single-family homes, condos, townhomes, and vacation rentals.
- [Commercial Refinishing](https://bath-professional.com/#commercial-refinishing-tampa): High-volume bathtub, shower, tile, and countertop refinishing for hotels, resorts, apartment complexes, senior living facilities, and property managers.
